page.notes: Left margin: a short stray dash beside "Quis interim" is not transcribed. The Hebrew margin word after the first note is read as מאן with doubt. The Greek word "Βερξιυτ" is uncertain. The Arabic words are copied as best read, and their vowel marks are not reliable. The final word of the text is cut off at the line end, and the catchword "tu" is read at the lower right. The first note's text "Buxtr" is probably a printing error for "Buxtorf". The Hebrew line "אחת לטוב ואחתלרע" may have a word break missing.
